029import static org.tquadrat.foundation.perflog.PerformanceSection.PerformanceSectionFlags.SEND_REPORT_FOR_ABORT;

046/**
047 *  <p>{@summary This class describes a &quot;Performance Section&quot;.}</p>
048 *
049 *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
050 *  @version $Id: PerformanceSection.java 1258 2026-06-04 18:33:06Z tquadrat $
051 *  @since 0.25.0
052 *
053 *  @UMLGraph.link
054 */
055@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerformanceSection.java 1258 2026-06-04 18:33:06Z tquadrat $" )
056@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.0" )
057public final class PerformanceSection
058{
059        /*---------------*\
060    ====** Inner Classes **====================================================
061        \*---------------*/
062    /**
063     *  <p>{@summary The flags that control the behaviour of a performance
064     *  section.}</p>
065     *
066     *  @extauthor Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
067     *  @version $Id: PerformanceSection.java 1258 2026-06-04 18:33:06Z tquadrat $
068     *  @since 0.25.0
069     *
070     *  @UMLGraph.link
071     */
072    @ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: PerformanceSection.java 1258 2026-06-04 18:33:06Z tquadrat $" )
073    @API( status = STABLE, since = "0.25.0" )
074    public static enum PerformanceSectionFlags
075    {
076        /**
077         *  <p>{@summary The performance section will be ignored.}</p>
078         */
079        IGNORED,
080
081        /**
082         *  <p>{@summary Indicates that a report should be sent also for
083         *  aborted performance trackers.}</p>
084         */
085        SEND_REPORT_FOR_ABORT,
086
087        /**
088         *  <p>{@summary Indicates that reports should be sent only when the
089         *  threshold was exceeded.}</p>
090         */
091        SEND_REPORT_ONLY_FOR_EXCEEDED_THRESHOLD
092    }
093    //  enum PerformanceSectionFlags
094
095        /*------------*\
096    ====** Attributes **=======================================================
097        \*------------*/
098    /**
099     *  The description for the performance section.
100     */
101    private final String m_Description;
102
103    /**
104     *  The flog that controls whether this performance section is ignored.
105     */
106    private boolean m_Ignore;
107
108    /**
109     *  The flag that controls whether reports for this performance section are
110     *  sent in case of an abort.
111     */
112    private boolean m_SendReportForAbort;
113
114    /**
115     *  The flag that controls whether reports for this performance section are
116     *  sent only when the threshold was exceeded.
117     */
118    private boolean m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold;
119
120    /**
121     *  The unique name of the performance section.
122     */
123    private final PerformanceSectionName m_Name;
124
125    /**
126     *  The guard for read operations.
127     */
128    private final AutoLock m_ReadGuard;
129
130    /**
131     *  <p>{@summary The threshold time.} A value of {@null} means that
132     *  there is no threshold for this performance section.</p>
133     */
134    private TimeValue m_Threshold = null;
135
136    /**
137     *  <p>{@summary The timeout time.} A value of {@null} means that
138     *  there is no timeout for this performance section.</p>
139     */
140    private TimeValue m_Timeout = null;
141
142    /**
143     *  The guard for write operations.
144     */
145    private final AutoLock m_WriteGuard;
146
147        /*--------------*\
148    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
149        \*--------------*/
150    /**
151     *  <p>{@summary {@constructor}}</p>
152     *
153     *  @param  name    The unique name of the performance section.
154     *  @param  description The description for the performance section; can be
155     *      {@null}.
156     *  @param  threshold   The threshold time in milliseconds; a value of
157     *      {@null} means that no threshold was defined for this
158     *      performance section. A value less than 1 is invalid and causes a
159     *      {@link IllegalArgumentException}
160     *      to be thrown.
161     *  @param  timeout The timeout time in milliseconds; a value of
162     *      {@null} means that no timeout was defined for this performance
163     *      section. A value less than 1 is invalid and causes a
164     *      {@link IllegalArgumentException}
165     *      to be thrown. The timeout value must be greater than the threshold
166     *      value, if provided.
167     *  @param  flags   Provides the configuration for this performance
168     *      section.
169     */
170    public PerformanceSection( final String name, final String description, final Long threshold, final Long timeout, final PerformanceSectionFlags... flags )
171    {
172        this(
173            createPerformanceSectionName( name ),
174            description,
175            isNull( threshold ) ? null : new TimeValue( MILLISECOND, requireValidArgument( threshold, "threshold", t -> t > 0L ) ),
176            isNull( timeout ) ? null : new TimeValue( MILLISECOND, requireValidArgument( timeout, "timeout", t -> t > 0L ) ),
177            flags
178        );
179    }   //  PerformanceSection()
180
181    /**
182     *  <p>{@summary {@constructor}}</p>
183     *
184     *  @param  name    The unique name of the performance section.
185     *  @param  description The description for the performance section; can be
186     *      {@null}.
187     *  @param  threshold   The threshold time; a value of {@null} means
188     *      that no threshold was defined for this performance section. A value
189     *      of 0 is invalid and causes a
190     *      {@link IllegalArgumentException}
191     *      to be thrown.
192     *  @param  timeout The timeout time; a value of {@null} means that
193     *      no timeout was defined for this performance section. A value of 0
194     *      is invalid and causes a
195     *      {@link IllegalArgumentException}
196     *      to be thrown. The timeout value must be greater than the threshold
197     *      value, if provided.
198     *  @param  flags   Provides the configuration for this performance
199     *      section.
200     */
201    public PerformanceSection( final PerformanceSectionName name, final String description, final TimeValue threshold, final TimeValue timeout, final PerformanceSectionFlags... flags )
202    {
203        m_Description = mapFromEmpty( description, "?" );
204        final Set<PerformanceSectionFlags> flagsSet = EnumSet.noneOf( PerformanceSectionFlags.class );
205        flagsSet.addAll( asList( requireNonNullArgument( flags, "flags" ) ) );
206        m_Ignore = flagsSet.contains( IGNORED );
207        m_Name = requireNonNullArgument( name, "name" );
208        m_SendReportForAbort = flagsSet.contains( SEND_REPORT_FOR_ABORT );
209        m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold = flagsSet.contains( SEND_REPORT_ONLY_FOR_EXCEEDED_THRESHOLD );
210        m_Threshold = validateThresholdAndTimeout( threshold, threshold, null );
211        m_Timeout = validateThresholdAndTimeout( timeout, threshold, timeout );
212
213        final var lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
214        m_ReadGuard = AutoLock.of( lock.readLock() );
215        m_WriteGuard = AutoLock.of( lock.writeLock() );
216    }   //  PerformanceSection()
217
218        /*---------*\
219    ====** Methods **==========================================================
220        \*---------*/
221    /**
222     * {@inheritDoc}
223     * <p>Two instances of {@code PerformanceSection} are equal if their names
224     * are equal.</p>
225     */
226    @Override
227    public final boolean equals( final Object o )
228    {
229        var retValue = this == o;
230        if( !retValue && o instanceof final PerformanceSection other )
231        {
232            retValue = getName().equals( other.getName() );
233        }
234
235        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
236        return retValue;
237    }   //  equals()
238
239    /**
240     *  Returns the description for the performance section.
241     *
242     *  @return The description for the performance section.
243     */
244    public final String getDescription() { return m_Description; }
245
246    /**
247     *  Returns the name of the performance section.
248     *
249     *  @return The name of the performance section.
250     */
251    public final PerformanceSectionName getName() { return m_Name; }
252
253    /**
254     *  Returns the threshold for this performance section.
255     *
256     *  @return An instance of
257     *      {@link OptionalLong}
258     *      that holds the threshold in milliseconds.
259     */
260    public final Optional<TimeValue> getThreshold()
261    {
262        final var retValue = m_ReadGuard.execute( () -> m_Threshold );
263
264        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
265        return retValue;
266    }   //  getThreshold()
267
268    /**
269     *  Returns the timeout for this performance section.
270     *
271     *  @return An instance of
272     *      {@link OptionalLong}
273     *      that holds the timeout in milliseconds.
274     */
275    public final Optional<TimeValue> getTimeout()
276    {
277        final var retValue = m_ReadGuard.execute( () -> m_Timeout );
278
279        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
280        return retValue;
281    }   //  getTimeout()
282
283    /**
284     * {@inheritDoc}
285     * <p>Two instances of {@code PerformanceSection} are equal if their names
286     * are equal.</p>
287     */
288    @Override
289    public final int hashCode() { return getName().hashCode(); }
290
291    /**
292     *  Returns the flag that controls whether this performance section is
293     *  ignored.
294     *
295     *  @return {@true} if the performance section is currently ignored,
296     *      {@false} if the performance section is currently observed.
297     */
298    public final boolean isIgnored() { return m_ReadGuard.evaluate( () -> m_Ignore ); }
299
300    /**
301     *  Returns the flag that indicates whether reports should be sent if a
302     *  {@link PerformanceTracker}
303     *  is aborted.
304     *
305     *  @return {@true} if a report should be sent, {@false} if not.
306     *
307     *  @see PerformanceTracker#abort(String)
308     *  @see PerformanceTracker#abort(String, Throwable)
309     */
310    public final boolean isSendingReportForAbort() { return m_ReadGuard.evaluate( () -> m_SendReportForAbort ); }
311
312    /**
313     *  <p>{@summary Returns the flag that indicates whether reports should be
314     *  sent only if the threshold was exceeded.}</p>
315     *
316     *  @return {@true} if a report should be sent only when the threshold
317     *      was exceeded, {@false} if a report should be sent always.
318     */
319    public final boolean isSendingReportOnlyForExceededThreshold() { return m_ReadGuard.evaluate( () -> m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold ); }
320
321    /**
322     *  Sets the flag that controls whether this performance section is
323     *  ignored.
324     *
325     *  @param  flag    {@true} if the performance section should be
326     *      ignored from now on, {@false} if it has to be observed in
327     *      future.
328     */
329    public final void setIgnoreFlag( final boolean flag ) { m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_Ignore = flag ); }
330
331    /**
332     *  Sets the flag that controls whether reports are sent also for aborted
333     *  {@linkplain PerformanceTracker performance trackers}.
334     *
335     *  @param  flag {@true} if reports should be sent, {@false} if
336     *      not.
337     */
338    public final void setSendReportForAbortFlag( final boolean flag )
339    {
340        m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_SendReportForAbort = flag );
341    }   //  setSendReportForAbortFlag()
342
343    /**
344     *  <p>{@summary Sets the flag that controls whether reports are sent only
345     *  when the threshold was exceeded.}</p>
346     *
347     *  @param  flag {@true} if reports should be sent only when the
348     *      threshold was exceeded, {@false} if reports should be sent
349     *      always.
350     */
351    public final void setSendReportOnlyForExceededThresholdFlag( final boolean flag )
352    {
353        m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold = flag );
354    }   //  setSendReportOnlyForExceededThresholdFlag()
355
356    /**
357     *  Sets the threshold and enables it.
358     *
359     *  @param  value   The new threshold value; must be greater than 0.
360     */
361    public final void setThreshold( final TimeValue value )
362    {
363        try
364        {
365            m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_Threshold = validateThreshold( value ) );
366        }
367        catch( final ExecutionFailedException e )
368        {
369            final var cause = e.getCause();
370            if( cause instanceof final IllegalArgumentException iae ) throw iae;
371            throw e;
372        }
373    }   //  setThreshold()
374
375    /**
376     *  Sets the timeout and enables it.
377     *
378     *  @param  value   The new timeout value; must be greater than 0.
379     */
380    public final void setTimeout( final TimeValue value )
381    {
382        try
383        {
384            m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_Timeout = validateTimeout( value ) );
385        }
386        catch( final ExecutionFailedException e )
387        {
388            final var cause = e.getCause();
389            if( cause instanceof final IllegalArgumentException iae ) throw iae;
390            throw e;
391        }
392    }   //  setTimeout()
393
394    /**
395     *  Disables the threshold for this performance section.
396     */
397    public final void switchOffThreshold() { m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_Threshold = null ); }
398
399    /**
400     *  Disables the timeout for this performance section.
401     */
402    public final void switchOffTimeout() { m_WriteGuard.perform( () -> m_Timeout = null ); }
403
404    /**
405     * {@inheritDoc}
406     */
407    @Override
408    public final String toString()
409    {
410        final var buffer = new StringBuilder( "PerformanceSection{" )
411            .append( "m_Name='" ).append( m_Name ).append( "', " )
412            .append( "m_Description='" ).append( m_Description ).append( "', " )
413            .append( "m_Threshold=" );
414        try( final var _ = m_ReadGuard.lock() )
415        {
416            if( nonNull( m_Threshold ) )
417            {
418                buffer.append( "%s".formatted( m_Threshold ) );
419            }
420            else
421            {
422                buffer.append( "none" );
423            }
424            buffer.append( ", m_Timeout=" );
425            if( nonNull( m_Timeout ) )
426            {
427                buffer.append( "%s".formatted( m_Timeout ) );
428            }
429            else
430            {
431                buffer.append( "none" );
432            }
433            buffer.append( ", m_Ignore=" ).append( m_Ignore )
434                .append( ", m_SendReportForAbort=" ).append( m_SendReportForAbort )
435                .append( ", m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold=" ).append( m_SendReportOnlyForExceededThreshold )
436                .append( '}' );
437        }
438        final var retValue = buffer.toString();
439
440        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
441        return retValue;
442    }   //  toString()
443
444    /**
445     *  <p>{@summary Validates the given threshold.}</p>
446     *  <p>The value must be greater than 0, and, if the
447     *  timeout is not {@null}, it must be less than the timeout.</p>
448     *
449     *  @note The method is called from inside a guarded area only!
450     *
451     *  @param  value   The value for the threshold.
452     *  @return The given value.
453     *  @throws IllegalArgumentException The value is invalid.
454     */
455    private final TimeValue validateThreshold( final TimeValue value ) throws IllegalArgumentException
456    {
457        final var retValue = validateThresholdAndTimeout( requireNonNullArgument( value, "threshold" ), value, m_Timeout );
458
459        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
460        return retValue;
461    }   //  validateThreshold()
462
463    /**
464     *  <p>{@summary Validates threshold and timeout.}</p>
465     *  <p>Both values must be either -1 or greater than 0, and, if the
466     *  threshold is not -1, the timeout must be greater than the
467     *  threshold.</p>
468     *
469     *  @param  retValue    The return value.
470     *  @param  threshold   The value for the threshold.
471     *  @param  timeout The value for the timeout.
472     *  @return The return value.
473     *  @throws IllegalArgumentException A value is invalid.
474     */
475    @SuppressWarnings( "OverlyComplexMethod" )
476    private static final TimeValue validateThresholdAndTimeout( final TimeValue retValue, final TimeValue threshold, final TimeValue timeout ) throws IllegalArgumentException
477    {
478        if( nonNull( retValue ) && !retValue.equals( threshold ) && !retValue.equals( timeout ) ) throw new IllegalArgumentException( "return value is neither threshold nor timeout" );
479        if( nonNull( threshold ) && threshold.value().longValue() < 1L ) throw new IllegalArgumentException( "threshold value '%s' is invalid".formatted( threshold ) );
480        if( nonNull( timeout ) && timeout.value().longValue() < 1L ) throw new IllegalArgumentException( "timeout value '%s' is invalid".formatted( timeout ) );
481        if( nonNull( timeout ) && nonNull( threshold ) && timeout.baseValue().compareTo( threshold.baseValue() ) <= 0 ) throw new IllegalArgumentException( "timeout value '%s' is not greater than threshold value '%s'".formatted( timeout, threshold ) );
482
483        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
484        return retValue;
485    }   //  validateThresholdAndTimeout()
486
487    /**
488     *  <p>{@summary Validates the given timeout.}</p>
489     *  <p>The value must be greater than 0, and, if the threshold is not
490     *  {@null}, the timeout must be greater than the threshold.</p>
491     *
492     *  @note The method is called from inside a guarded area only!
493     *
494     *  @param  value   The value for the timeout.
495     *  @return The given value.
496     *  @throws IllegalArgumentException The value is invalid.
497     */
498    private final TimeValue validateTimeout( final TimeValue value ) throws IllegalArgumentException
499    {
500        final var retValue = validateThresholdAndTimeout( requireNonNullArgument( value, "timeout" ), m_Threshold, value );
501
502        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
503        return retValue;
504    }   //  validateThresholdAndTimeout()
505}
506//  class PerformanceSection
